purpose: Attack current PC01/PC02/PC03 and E01/E02/E03 with existing Experience, Counterexample and Counterexample-Theme memory before allocating another playable integration.
claimBoundary: Mechanical recomposition falsification only. No Human value, product selection, G0 admission, market claim, or Game Core change follows.

recompositionProbes.attack: Test whether E01's entire proven information-to-corrective-action property is already contained inside PC01's diagnosed hidden-cause architecture choice.
recompositionProbes.falsifier: If E01 contributes a mechanically distinct state, action, consequence or transfer relation not already present in PC01, subsumption fails; otherwise no integration is admitted.

recompositionProbes.attack: Test whether E02's stable relational-rule transfer is already contained inside PC03's same-rule multi-gap bidirectional traversal.
recompositionProbes.falsifier: If E02 adds a transfer dimension beyond PC03's already-tested stable-rule reuse and timing-sensitive execution, subsumption fails; otherwise no integration is admitted.

recompositionProbes.attack: Inject one bounded commit lag while preserving PC01 hidden-cause legibility and ask whether forecastable context age changes optimal diagnosis/commit policy rather than merely adding waiting cost.
recompositionProbes.falsifier: R03 survives only if at least one policy structure changes under lag and diagnosis still has positive expected value. The coupling is explicitly conditional on hidden cause persistence plus a forecastable next operating context.

recompositionProbes.attack: Delay context response and test whether E03 can create a non-redundant consequence without breaking PC02's immutable revision/source attribution or granting audience feedback mechanical authority.
recompositionProbes.falsifier: If delayed feedback remains exactly revision-bound and non-authoritative, lag is mechanically inert for the current carrier and the combination is no-fit. If lag gains effect only by breaking attribution/authority, it also fails.

stressProbes.attack: Check whether the explicit intent axis currently changes downstream creation semantics or only gates commit admissibility.
stressProbes.falsifier: Trace which downstream functions consume intent versus artifact geometry; do not upgrade a metadata/admission effect into Human authorship or expressive-intent evidence.

stressProbes.attack: Stress E03 with imperfect transition models to expose the transfer boundary of anticipation value.
stressProbes.falsifier: Compare perfect, reactive, wrong-direction and constant-lane prediction under the unchanged lag-1 target dynamics.
